detail.longDescription:
Stay on top of GitHub’s performance—anytime, anywhere.

GitHub Status is a fast, native iOS app that gives you real-time visibility into GitHub’s infrastructure, so you’re never caught off guard by outages, degraded performance, or maintenance events.

Whether you’re shipping code, managing deployments, or just keeping an eye on uptime, this app puts everything you need in one place.

DASHBOARD OVERVIEW

Get a complete snapshot of GitHub’s health at a glance:

- Overall system status
- Global API latency
- 30-day uptime metrics
- Per-service health indicators

INCIDENT HISTORY

Track what’s happening—and what already happened:

- Chronological incident timeline
- Grouped by month for easy browsing
- Full details on outages and resolutions

Stay informed without constantly checking:

- Major outages
- Degraded performance
- Scheduled maintenance

Customize alerts to match your workflow.

BUILT FOR SPEED AND SIMPLICITY

- Native SwiftUI design
- Smooth, responsive experience
- Automatic background refresh
- No unnecessary complexity

PRIVACY FIRST
- No tracking
- No analytics
- No data collection
- Uses only GitHub’s public Status API

MADE FOR DEVELOPERS

Perfect for engineers, DevOps, and teams who rely on GitHub every day.

100% unofficial. Made by @leereilly.
